AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.RESIGN_DATE)), '') IS NULL OR A.RESIGN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)) AND A.JOIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)
AND A.RESIGN_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.RESIGN_DATE < CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)
ORDER BY A.EMP_NO

SELECT A.ABSENT_CD AS ABSENT_CD, A.ABSENT_NAME AS ABSENT_NAME, A.ABSENT_DESC AS ABSENT_DESC, A.ORDER_SEQ AS ORDER_SEQ FROM dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY A.ORDER_SEQ

SELECT A.ABSENT_CD AS ABSENT_CD, A.ABSENT_NAME AS ABSENT_NAME, A.ORDER_SEQ AS ORDER_SEQ FROM dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = ( CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE}) THEN #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ELSE '10001' END) ORDER BY A.ORDER_SEQ

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.ABSENT_CD AS ABSENT_CD, A.ABSENT_NAME AS ABSENT_NAME, A.ABSENT_DESC AS ABSENT_DESC, A.REG_DATE AS REG_DATE, ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') AS USE_YN, A.ORDER_SEQ AS ORDER_SEQ FROM dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM AS A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY A.ORDER_SEQ, A.ABSENT_CD

insert.if:
INSERT INTO dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM ( OFFICE_CODE, ABSENT_CD, ABSENT_NAME, ABSENT_DESC, REG_DATE, USE_YN, ORDER_SEQ )
SELECT #{row.LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE}, #{row.ABSENT_CD}, #{row.ABSENT_NAME}, #{row.ABSENT_DESC}, #{row.REG_DATE}, #{row.USE_YN}, #{row.ORDER_SEQ}

if.foreach: INSERT INTO dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM ( OFFICE_CODE, ABSENT_CD, ABSENT_NAME, ABSENT_DESC, REG_DATE, USE_YN, ORDER_SEQ ) SELECT #{row.LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE}, ABSENT_CD, ABSENT_NAME, ABSENT_DESC, CONVERT(char(8), GETDATE(), 112), USE_YN, ORDER_SEQ FROM dbo.TAD_ABSENT_ITEM WHERE OFFICE_CODE = '10001'
